notes.title: Pneumata - update news sep. 19
notes.content:
[p]Hey it's Antonio the dev guy who made this game.

An update is still on it's way, so if you own the game, I'll try and send out a big notification or something to let you know. It's pretty significant, won't feel like you're playing the same game at all.

If you haven't bought the game, just wait until the update's out.

More news on September 19, 2025. Only fitting as the 1 year anniversary of the launch comes through.[/p]

notes.title: Pneumata: Redux - Coming Q1 2025
notes.content:
Hello! Antonio here,

Pneumata was my life for several years and is my passion project. And however much I tried to avoid falling short with my debut title, the game had lots of issues.

Whether it was burnout or tunnel vision, it looks like what I really needed was to take a step back and also soak in the community feedback to really understand what Pneumata needs in order to become what it should have been on launch: An incredible entry to the Survival Horror genre.

So with that, I'm announcing that an awesome update is coming - Pneumata: Redux

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43114956/450c6959f65242ba68639de5a292a3b74b5b930c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43114956/84f1f5d4bd6c595d8f55262901237d15d14ab428.png[/img]

I've been able to rediscover what Pneumata was supposed to be, and will be addressing major issues as well as redefining the game.

Among other things being worked on, here are some highlights:

- A 3rd Person Mode, to experience the game from a whole new perspective
- Improved atmosphere and a complete relighting of the game (No longer too dark)
- New Enemies that react and behave much more realistically, as well as being more balanced and terrifying.
- Improved combat that brings weight and impact
- Narrative rework that aims to hit harder
- Sound redesign
- Items and Resources management that adds life to the game
- Updated level design for a more cohesive and interconnected world that flows naturally

More to come on this soon, with the planned release of this update coming Q1 2025. The update will be free for everyone who has purchased the game already, and will offer a transformative experience from the launch version of the game as well as replayability.

Thanks!
-Antonio

notes.title: Content Update 1 - Maps + Minor General Improvements
notes.content:
Hello!

Today's update is the first of several content related updates on the way: 

Hand drawn maps for each level have been added in, that can be accessed anytime to help navigate through the game, as well as minor general improvements.

More work is being done to bring additional bug fixes in a large update coming soon, however some of these reworks require some major tweaks to some of the core systems so I want to be careful to make sure that enough testing is done on these fixes.

notes.title: Update Notes for October 3, 2024
notes.content:
Hello!

A new minor update is bringing some fixes as well as subtitles.

[b]Patch Notes[/b]:
- Subtitles added for spoken dialogues
- Fixed an issue with a wall clipping through the exterior and blocking the vents outside Clover Hill.
- Fixed an issue with player getting stuck inside moving Fridges

More bug fixes are being worked on right now, and will go live once I'm able to get some more testing on them going. Expect a major update in the next week or so that will bring some accessibility options, bug fixes, and some design changes to help with exploring the world with a bit more ease.

Thanks!
-Antonio

notes.title: First Update Out Now - Save Issues and Localization
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Antonio here, the developer for Pneumata.

I've been taking a careful look at all the feedback and working hard on getting patches out for the various issues encountered within the game. I'm committed to fixing core issues, as well as general updates and improvements to the overall experience of the game. 

The first patch will go live today on 09/27/2024 at 10:00am PST.

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
- Fixed issue with save data related to the island being lost
- Fixed issue with save data from previous runs affecting a new playthrough
- Localization now live for the first set of languages:
    - French
    - German
    - Italian
    - Spanish
    - Portuguese

I'm working hard to roll out these updates in a timely manner and will be working towards consistent updates, but as a solo dev I also want to be careful about rushing updates. Keep an eye out for more news/updates regarding upcoming patches and improvements coming very soon.

Thank you to everyone for supporting the game, even through a difficult launch. I plan to take all the feedback and address the issues and concerns relating to the game.

notes.title: NEW DEMO! - Pneumata new demo out now - Roadmap and Plans for the future
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Antonio here, the developer behind Pneumata, just letting y'all know there's a new demo out.

Start the demo in the sewers, as you try to make it through to the detention center.

Pneumata is a story based game with a lot of narrative elements, and in order to avoid spoiling the story I picked the sewers to be where the demo takes place.

I want your feedback and help to make sure that the game feels great, and to fix issues with the game regarding gameplay and combat.

I will be constantly updating the demo to provide a great experience and develop the game alongside the community for these next couple of weeks. Together we can make a great game!

Key Features Coming:
Brutal Finishers
Brutal Deaths
Blocking System

Today's Update 11am PST:
- Sprinting on Gamepad is toggleable
- Reduced Camera Shake when stomping
- Easier to kill smaller enemies
- Damage post process reduced intensity and only triggered when health below 50%

Thanks!
